slide.heading: Quel âge a-t-il ?
slide.lead:
Il a douze ans. = He is twelve.
Elle a douze ans. = She is twelve.

points.label: Age
points.text: Use a… ans, not est… ans.

points.label: Description
points.text: Use est: Il est gentil. = He is kind.

figure.shows: French numbers from one to twenty in two pairs of columns
figure.alt: French numbers one to twenty, from un to vingt.
